Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' Teaser Released, Disha Patani Co-stars

The teaser for 'Awarapan 2', a sequel to the 2007 film 'Awarapan', has been released by Vishesh Films. The film stars Emraan Hashmi reprising his role and Disha Patani in a lead capacity. The teaser features Hashmi in an action-oriented avatar and includes a new version of an iconic song.
